settings.cell_boundary: (arm, round) — one process per phase per round, which is what makes load.foreign_busy_cpus attributable to a cell; the three implementations are timed inside one invocation so a ratio's two arms share one host state

statistics.ratio_estimator: mean of the per-round paired quotient subject/baseline, with a one-sample BCa interval over those quotients

memory.why_no_interval: Deterministic allocator accounting — identical in every round, and verified so here. AGENTS.md 8.4 scopes interval requirements to continuous and sampling metrics; an interval on an exact count would be wrong, not missing.

why_no_verdicts: Verdicts are read against docs/benchmarks/rocksdb_memtable/METHODOLOGY.md by a reviewer; this driver emits the intervals and does not decide them.

estimators.ratio: mean over rounds of (subject Mops / baseline Mops) measured in the same invocation, with a one-sample BCa 95% interval over those paired quotients — not a two-sample ratio of the two columns beside it
estimators.columns: per-arm columns are means of the same rounds' Mops/s
estimators.raw: every cell carries rounds_raw, the per-round samples and that cell's load
